newsitem.title: USA: AMR cargo unit head quits, successor named.
newsitem.headline: AMR cargo unit head quits, successor named.

text.p: AMR Corp's American Airlines said Monday that William Boesch had retired from his post as president of the airline's cargo division, which he had held for the last eight years.
It said Boesch is being succeeded by David Brooks, who has been serving as president of the Airline Services Division of AMR Services Corp.
Boesch, who is retiring to pursue other interests, has nevertheless agreed to remain as chairman of the cargo division until the end of the year to ensure a smooth transition, it said.
